Ianthe: Compassionate, fair, wholly loving and frisky in the appropriate way and with the appropriate people, Ianthe has saved the day on so many occasions it's not funny. Not that she notices, usually. She's just being Ianthe and all of us are very glad she is.
Ilan: No, Ilan doesn't begin a project lightly. She's thought about it, considered the pros and cons of both success and failure, while understanding that change is an inevitable part of the journey. If she's not already, we anticipate every success for this girl. Indeed, we up here in the commentary box have been talking about her lately and what we want to see more of this season is some pure, unadulterated, impulsive irresponsibility.
Ilani: Ilani's soul is infused with a rich vein of calm compassion for her fellow man. She takes a long time to get over people and/or moments that are hurtful but she always recovers to a position of being glad it happened. As a very gifted, if not hidden, artist, we up here in the commentary box have strung out some Tibetan prayer flags and said a few short words each in the hope that she turns up for this afternoon's game.
Ilde: Ilde can look at a situation, speak to one witness, taste the wind with an eye of skepticism and then accurately describe the whole event. She’d make a fine detective and a wonderful hooker, both occupations for which no one would suspect her, of her, which is why she’d be grand at either. You got all that?
Ilena: Ilena's walk-in wardrobe looks like someone has set-off a small bomb. If she gets up to visit the loo in the middle of the night you can be guaranteed that, if she doesn't turn the lights on, you're going to hear her curse after standing on an unseen upturned stiletto. We've talked about it here in the commentary box and we're amazed she manages to get to the ground on time, which she always does. Stranger than that, she can actually play the game.
Ilene: Ilene catches crocodiles for a living.
Iliana: No, we wouldn't call her unadventurous either. Iliana's previous lives have all centred around positions of power and prestige. Here in this life she's still got the ego and all that, but she's about having a lot more silly fun. Sure, in eons gone by she sent many-a-peasant to their death but we all live and learn. This girl loves to travel, she loves exotic men/partners and she rarely steps out of the house looking like an unmade bed.
Ilona: Sure, she's a loner sometimes but only because she's way more intelligent than everyone else, and what's the point of hanging around with idiots when you're striving to make a difference in the scientific world? All they'll do is drag you down. But, don't forget that this great intelligence makes her very funny.
Imby: Bouncy, irreverent and funny, Imby is a distant cousin of Nina, and the name given to the act of base-jumping from a very tall cliff, having just been told an excellent joke immediately beforehand.
Imelda: Cute and mysterious, no one is sure if Imelda is the consummate actress or if this is just how she is. The only certainty is that she is affiliated with the artistic world, someway, somehow.
Imogen: Imogen has multiple orgasms nearly every day and therefore always looks like she’s about to have another one. Nice work if you can get it.
Imola: Nothing wrong with a strategic nipple-flash, she’ll tell you. Yes, she’s savvy and smart but, and I quote, “I have the looks, so why not?”
Ina: A very bright and busy girl. Too busy to talk to us, though. (She currently aspires to work for Wiki-leaks.)
Inca:
You know, mum and dad, it's 2019...maybe even 2020 or 2022 by the time you get to read this, and you do know the Incas were basically wiped out in the 16th Century? Are you aware of that?

Hang on, did you also consider Inuit as a name? What about Mongol? Or Zulu? (Actually, that's not a bad one). Anyway, the point is, Inca is probably not related to the Incas, unless you conceived her inside an ancient Mexican temple. Did you? No? Okay, well, here we are. Inca is a gentle soul, never in-your-face, and we sincerely hope she doesn't become a social worker. Don't worry, it's a noble profession and we need them, but Inca has a brain and we hope she ends up operating at the other end of the social spectrum where she forges new philosophies and/or technologies which look forward, not mopping up after those who were dealt a dodgy hand.  Inca? Thoughts? Prognostications?...
Inda: Carried aloft by her seven Egyptian slaves who cater to her every whim, Inda floats around with an air of devilish intent that beguiles all those who are lucky enough to get close to her. She doesn’t intend to, but somehow she manages to walk the red carpet, even when doing something as banal as brushing her teeth.
Indi: Monty Python would have loved her because her name is woody, luscious, mysterious and inviting. And so she is....
India: Well, I suppose it’s a far sexier name than Northern Ireland, but who’s to say? In any case, and despite her parents’ best intentions, India is just a normal girl living a normal life.
Indiana: Honey, don't be scared to scream your head off if you feel like it. True, society frowns upon such things, but that's exactly WHY you should. You with me? Bust out baby!
Indigo: Shy at first, Indigo assumes an extremely oblique approach to the universe and any kind of standard job, therefore, isn't any of her business. She's far too spiritual for that. She meditates daily and breathes slowly and deeply anyway, the immediate result being that her decisions often take a while to arrive. The universe doesn't just offer up solutions straight away, you know. Sometimes you have to wait. But, she knows that whatever the decision is, it will be the right one.
Indira: Her name folds over on itself like a thick, wood-fired pizza dough made by a meastro in his or her field. Indira concerns herself with the rights and wrongs of the world, and of her friends. Some people don't have time for irreverent, silly fun and that's okay. Some niches are more important and carry more weight than others. Indira.
Indra: Indra acts as a mainstay for her friends. She's reliable and honest and trustworthy, and she's becoming weary of being the constant shoulder for some of her peers who keep making the same mistakes with men, work and everything else, over and over and over again.
Ines: She makes an excellent captain and a fearless leader. She spots idiots in an instant and she orgasms easily and loudly if the situation permits. She's never broke and the idea of cooking all day is enough to maker her want to kill her partner/anybody.
Inez: Inez makes an excellent private investigator. She's abit odd, but then again so are the people who have employed her, usually.
Infinity:
Be careful what you wish for, girl. And just take it easy, eh?
Management.
Inga: Go on a date with Inga and you better be prepared. You might end up married, you might end up being chased by a bloody lion that escaped from the zoo - via one of these hilarious and ridiculous feats of coincidence that seem to happen to Inga all the time - and then again you might end up head over heels in love with three kids. You never know with this one but what a ride!
Inge: Another realist. Inge gives her all but as an older soul who knows the rules, she understands that extreme exertion, in whatever form that is, will only get her so far before the hands of luck and karma step in for the final say.
Inger: Inger used to hunt in Africa, professionally. Thankfully she saw the light and now she leads tourists with cameras. She's quite tough, you know.
Ingrid: Pragmatic and European, usually, Ingrid is also the name of a plate of short bread biscuits that are slightly burnt. You look at them, expecting them to do something, but nothing happens. They just sit there. (ie. here’s another woman who could do with a bit more ME time and a few less chores.)
Iona: In a myriad of ways, Iona is a complete mystery. In the middle of her name is a really cool little alley-way, and inside it are all kinds of intellectual, sensual and utterly playful scenarios. It's hard to explain, truth be known, but do you know what I mean?...
Ionda: Is she Norwegian? Perhaps, like our friend Prue, she hails from another planet altogether? Who knows? Either way, she's here as a conduit for peace, love and creative greatness, which she encourages in others. She doesn’t even mean to do it.
Ira: Ira favours her dog over her husband and her children.
Irena: The PhD student. What’s she studying? No idea, but she scurries about the hallways of academia with a determined look on her face, as if the secrets to the universe are almost within her grasp....
Irene: ‘Irene’ is what you say when one of the wings of the plane that you’re travelling on suddenly shears off. You then yell out ‘Irene’ as a blood-curdling scream that lasts for two full minutes until the end.
Iris: Like a hippopotamus wallowing in a water hole, Iris is intelligent, thoughtful, utterly confident of her position in the world, and she enjoys hysterical fun only when the time is right. Then she will be the one.
Irma: A great Clydesdale horse that remains unbothered by any din in her midst.
Isabel: Motherly and gentle, Isabel struggles with firing people. Indeed, being the boss isn't a position that sits well with her. Giving bad news is such a shocking prospect for her that, rather than have to tell someone they need to be let go, she'd prefer to go on holiday and not think about it at all. Is this the equivalent of sticking your head in a bucket of sand? Well, yes, I suppose it is but, on the flip side, she always, always puts other peoples' needs before her own. How many people you know do that?
Isabella: Winter time in Venice and Isabella walks through Piazza San Marco wrapped in a plush black coat, followed by the eyes of one hundred Italian men who know a gorgeous and self-confident woman when they see one. Absolutely.
Isabelle: Buxom and over-the-top, I don't think so. Isabelle is a thoughtful lass who considers her actions before they happen. She absorbs information easily and stores it for a very long time, if need be. Educated and healthy, she knows how to recycle and she's after a man who is respectable and polite, with friendly eyes and a warm smile.
Ishka: Ishka is a lover not a fighter, and the connection with the earth and Mother Nature is what is important here. She spent weeks living in a Mongolian ger until she tired of the yak milk, then she spent a year at an ashram in India where she got to meet the Dalai Lama. She has more bracelets than god, a hundred little feathery things in her hair and adorning her clothes, and at the forest doofs she is literally famous.
Isis:
God of love - not quite. More like the God of Love Me, and I Don't Care What Happens So Long As I Get What I Want.
Question: Is the spoilt?
Answer: Is the Pope Catholic?
Isla: Rarely given to life's drudgeries, Isla is a harmonious soul who leans ever-so-gently in the direction of the future. By nature therefore she is optimistic and caring, sexy and fun-loving. Her name is often used by Buddhist monks as a mantra which induces calm although male monks can be easily distracted by her good looks. For as the French attest, Isla is tres sexy.
Isobel: Isobel secretly wishes she was a dolphin where badness, hard drudgery and nasty people don't theoretically exist. If she attends mass on Sundays, then you can expect to see her at the pub Sunday arvo trying to unstraighten herself.
Isobelle: Isobelle never rules with an iron fist. Indeed, Isobelle would prefer someone else do the ruling, whether they are hard task-masters or not. As a gentle and friendly soul she doesn't belong anywhere near the corporate world and she avoids the television news which only serves to bring her down. She is a loving and attentive friend and teachers have always adored her pleasant demeanour and her good behaviour.
Issy: For kicks, Issy gets in her tinny, motors about 5 miles off shore, attaches herself to the boat with a rope after she dons her wetsuit, fins and goggles, then leaps over the side with her speargun. For the next three hours she'll duck-dive to around 30 metres and just relax for 3 or 4 minutes at a time, waiting for something big to show up. The bigger the better. She's fended off more sharks than you've had hot dinners. Issy.
Ita: I am. She is. You can. We are. You should, because life passes faster than you think…
Ivana: Ivana  makes no apologies and why should she? She is a scrumptious broad with flamboyant hair, mannerisms and fingernails. Like a well-bred wine she only gets better and hornier with age. If you can’t handle her, nick off.
Ivy: Ivy moves through her life like a wonderully happy and content plodding mammoth. You can't really see the smile but you know it's there, she quite likes the journey despite the deep rumblings that you might hear and her instinctive radar about where she's going and who she's dealing with work very well. Ivy.
Izzy: Izzy lives quite a neat little double life: As a daytime job she is one of the Army’s most gifted snipers and when she’s on leave she does pretty well on the stand-up comedy circuit.
